answer: Quadratic voting with identity staking: each identity must lock 20000 POA for 14 days before voting. Vote weight = sqrt(credits spent). Attacker creating N fake identities pays N × 20000 POA locked capital, cost growing linearly with N. System verifies via on-chain stake registry and timestamp checks; slashing 10% if duplicate identities detected via zk-proof of unique personhood. The 90% consensus threshold ensures coordinated attacks require 2x honest capital. Words: walnut, ridge, inlet.
